**Excel location:** [📊 Ergebnisse (Erg)]{.excel-menu .red} worksheet.

This worksheet contains tables and charts for the currently calculated variant. The training distinguishes it from the internal result store **OUT** and the [Excel Dashboard](excel-dashboard.qmd) for time-resolved analysis.

::: {.excel-path}
**Ribbon:** klimaaktiv PEQ → Ergebnisse → [Results]{.excel-action}
:::

## Project indicators

Check project and variant names, areas, use mix, building density, and cooled and mechanically ventilated shares. Confirm whether each balance is referenced to net or gross floor area.

## Heat balance {#heat-balance}

The charts compare transmission and ventilation losses, night ventilation, solar and internal gains, heating demand and cooling demand. Read the whole district, cooled and uncooled zones, and heating/cooling periods separately. Heating and cooling capacity are power values, not annual energy.

## Final-energy balance {#final-energy-balance}

The demand-coverage matrix assigns plug loads, building services, hot water, storage charging and mobility to coverage sources. Read imports, local use, storage flows and export within their respective balance boundaries; do not add them indiscriminately.

## Flexibility and battery

Availability periods, flexible use, battery charging/discharging, losses and cycles describe the use of available flexibility. Annual values complement the hourly analysis in the Dashboard.

## Primary-energy balance

Demand and coverage are assessed using conversion factors. Local renewables and flexible imports appear as substitution equivalents; context factors represent building density, refurbishment and mobility. The import/export view concerns exchange across the district boundary. Interpret both presentations using their own sign conventions and boundaries.

## GHG balance

Embodied and operational contributions, including mobility, are presented cumulatively. Emissions, credits, budget and balance are distinct quantities. Check the assessment period and gross-floor-area basis; [LCA inputs](climate.qmd) and [declaration](declaration.qmd) are documented separately.
